verbs.name: assemble.repurpose
verbs.description: AUTO-HIGHLIGHT SELECTION (long video -> short clips): pick the best `count` highlight segments from an asset's word-level transcript -- the selection 'intelligence' that transcript.assemble (build a reel from CHOSEN spans) and transcript.search (find spans by keyword) do NOT provide. NON-MUTATING: returns ranked candidate clips {rank, word_range:[lo,hi], range_ms, duration_ms, text, score, reason}; it never edits the timeline. Heuristic v1 (no model, deterministic): splits the words into sentence-ish units at long pauses, greedily packs them into ~target_ms candidates (capped at 1.5x), and scores each by speech density + ASR confidence + optional prompt-keyword overlap + duration fit. Feed a result's word_range into transcript.assemble for a highlight reel, or its range_ms into a sub-clip + render.reframe for a vertical short. Requires the asset to be transcribed (media.transcribe).

count.description: How many top segments to return (default 5).

target_ms.description: Target clip length in ms (default 30000); candidates are packed to ~this, capped at 1.5x.

prompt.description: Optional theme/keywords to bias selection toward (keyword overlap boosts a segment's score).

verbs.result: {asset, count, target_ms, clips:[{rank, word_range:[lo,hi], range_ms:[s,e], duration_ms, text, score, reason}], next}

verbs.name: assemble.shorts
verbs.description: AUTO-SHORTS PLANNER (one call: long transcribed video -> N ranked vertical-short PLANS). PURE orchestration over existing internals -- NO new model, NO rendering: it reuses assemble.repurpose's transcript ranker for the best `count` moments and, BEST-EFFORT, score.clip's perception-factor system for a per-short engagement breakdown. NON-MUTATING: returns PLANS only -- materializing each short (insert + crop + captions) is described by `next`. Each short is {rank, word_range:[lo,hi], range_ms:[s,e], duration_ms, score (0..100), reason, title (the first ~8 words as a hook line), factors? (omitted when the asset has no perception report), reframe:{aspect, crop:{x,y,w,h} fractions 0..1 of the SOURCE frame for a CENTER crop to the target aspect, or null when the probe lacks frame dimensions), has_captions:true}. `aspect` (default "9:16"; one of "9:16","1:1","4:5","16:9") sets the target. Honest degradation mirrors assemble.repurpose: an un-transcribed / empty-transcript asset is an INVALID_ARGS error (needs a speech transcript). Requires the asset to be transcribed (media.transcribe); a perception report is optional (adds `factors`).

count.description: How many top shorts to plan (default 5).

target_ms.description: Target short length in ms (default 30000); candidates are packed to ~this, capped at 1.5x.

aspect.description: Target aspect for the reframe center-crop (default "9:16").

prompt.description: Optional theme/keywords to bias selection toward (keyword overlap boosts a segment's score).

verbs.result: {asset, count, target_ms, aspect, shorts:[{rank, word_range:[lo,hi], range_ms:[s,e], duration_ms, score, reason, title, factors?, reframe:{aspect, crop:{x,y,w,h}|null}, has_captions}], next, note?}

verbs.name: assemble.from_script
verbs.description: SCRIPT-TO-TIMELINE matching: given a written `script` (one talking point per line) and a TRANSCRIBED asset, find the transcript span that best matches each script line -- IN ORDER -- so the chosen spans can be strung into a cut that follows the script. NON-MUTATING: returns the ordered match plan ({line_idx, script_line, matched, score, word_range:[lo,hi], range_ms, text}); it never edits the timeline. Deterministic token-overlap matcher (no model): for each line it scans forward from a cursor for the contiguous transcript-word window whose normalized token SET best overlaps the line (F1 = 2*|A intersect B|/(|A|+|B|)), within +-2 words of the line length; the cursor advances past each match so segments stay in script order and never overlap. A line whose best window scores below `min_score` (default 0.35) is reported unmatched (no range) rather than force-fit. Feed the returned `assemble_ranges` (the matched word_ranges, in order) into transcript.assemble to build the reel. Requires the asset to be transcribed (media.transcribe).

script.description: The script, one talking point/line per newline.

min_score.description: Minimum token-overlap F1 to count a line as matched (default 0.35).

verbs.result: {asset, min_score, total_lines, matched, segments:[{line_idx, script_line, matched, score, word_range:[lo,hi]|null, range_ms|null, text}], assemble_ranges:[[lo,hi]...], next}
